about: BN6's NaviCust program NumbrOpn (15, its pink variant 0x3C) placed at column 3, row 2 of BN6's own board and compiled by BN6 (ncp6): the Custom screen's hand is ten chips (BN6_NUMBROPN_CHECK, 0x0802A59C; the hand's count set to 10 at 0x0802A466), so the first Custom screen's second row holds the deck's sixth to tenth. A folder of ten chips (Cannon to Spreadr2, ids 1-10) dealt in that order; DOWN, RIGHT four times, A picks the tenth, START and A: MegaMan's next chip Spreadr2 (0xA) from the first fight frame (docs/multirom/bn6-gaps.md, NaviCust programs). Its control, ncp_numbropn_control, takes the same keys without the program.
subject: megaman
expect_why: The hand's tenth chip is on the screen only with NumbrOpn compiled; without it the same keys pick the fifth (Vulcan1, 0x5).
